people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.
translations.bsb: Woe to you, O Moab! You are destroyed, O people of Chemosh! He gave up his sons as refugees, and his daughters into captivity to Sihon king of the Amorites.
translations.kjv: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
translations.asv: Woe to thee, Moab! Thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: He hath given his sons as fugitives, And his daughters into captivity, Unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
